Purpose: To let every package register checks of the consumer's set-up, and to make the launch checks the
Caller and time: `doctor`; and `launch`, which runs the launch-blocking subset as its launch checks.
Inputs: A check: a stable dotted id; a severity rule; the flag `lb` (launch-blocking); an order; a probe
that receives injected probes; a message template of at most 200 bytes; a fix hint. `run`: the
context and the flags of the doctor.
Outputs: Findings, each with: id, severity, `lb`, message, fix, redacted evidence.
Errors: A probe that times out gives a warning `probe timed out`. A check that throws makes the doctor
exit 1 and does nothing to a run.
